promptText:
image_1 defines exactly one Aida: an elder bear with long flowing lilac-purple hair, a jewelled headdress across her brow, layered purple robes and a rose quartz pendant at her chest. Refer to it strictly. Do not use its pose or background.
image_2 defines only the sanctuary environment: a quiet cove shoreline with gentle waves and Aida's crystal singing bowl. Do not use or invent characters from it.
Exactly one Aida; no other characters appear.
The rose quartz pendant and its pink glow belong to Aida only.
Feature-quality stylized 3D CGI. Plush character materials with subsurface scattering; soft fur with individual strands catching the light; glossy eyes with bright catchlights. Warm amber key light with cool blue fill and a soft rim light; teal-orange cinematic grade. Shallow depth of field with soft bokeh, gentle ambient occlusion, subtle film grain. Appealing exaggerated proportions, large expressive eyes, soft rounded features. Emotionally warm atmosphere.
No dialogue in this beat; no narrator, no crowd, no added speech.

Shot 1 — the ritual. Camera: a slow push-in from a wide of the quiet cove toward Aida seated beside the crystal bowl. Gentle waves roll onto the shore. She runs the wand softly around the bowl's rim and a low shimmering tone rises <sustained crystal-bowl tone>; the cove seems to quiet around it — the water calms, the air stills. She closes her eyes. Her rose quartz pendant begins to glow, and soft pink light rises across her face from below, growing steadily stronger. Hold on her still, pink-lit face for two full seconds. End state: Aida perfectly still with eyes closed, her face lit in rose-pink, the bowl's tone sustained — a describable frame.

The singing-bowl tone is diegetic sound, not music. No music. No subtitles, captions or on-screen text. No watermark. No extra characters.

image_1 is the first frame — the vision imagery itself: a wooden pier, a small sailboat on bright blue water, Keen beside his Mum. Match its staging and positions exactly. The entire beat stays inside this vision: the image is washed in soft rose-pink light at its edges and gently glowing throughout, dreamlike but clear. Do not use image_1 to alter Keen or Mum identity; those are controlled only by image_2 and image_3.
image_2 defines exactly one Keen: a young blue bear cub with an upright white tuft on the crown of his head, a satchel worn across his body. Refer to it strictly. Do not use its pose or background.
image_3 defines exactly one Mum: a plump pale-blue adult bear, hair in a neat bun fronted by a pale-blue bow, an ornate gold collar. Refer to it strictly. Do not use its pose or background.
ATTRIBUTE OWNERSHIP: Keen's wrists and forearms stay completely bare for the entire beat — no wristbands, bands, bracelets, cuffs or straps of any kind appear on him. Exactly one Keen and one Mum; no other characters appear.
Feature-quality stylized 3D CGI. Plush character materials with subsurface scattering; soft fur with individual strands catching the light; glossy eyes with bright catchlights. Warm light with the rose-pink vision wash over everything; teal-orange base grade beneath it. Shallow depth of field with soft bokeh, subtle film grain. Appealing exaggerated proportions, large expressive eyes, soft rounded features. Emotionally warm atmosphere.
No dialogue in this beat — the vision is silent of speech; its sound stays muffled and distant <muffled waves and gulls, far away, soft and dreamlike>.

Shot 1 — what Aida sees. Camera: a slow gentle drift toward the pair on the pier, never cutting. Keen checks the straps on his satchel, then checks them again, then one more time — each check smaller and quicker than the last, his nerves showing in the repetition. His bare wrists are clearly visible as he works the straps. His Mum watches him with a proud smile that cannot quite hide her worry; one paw lifts slightly toward him and settles back. Hold the two of them for a full beat at the end. End state: Keen mid-check beside his Mum on the pier, the rose-pink wash steady — held as the vision's final image.

No music. No subtitles, captions or on-screen text. No watermark. No extra characters.

image_1 is the first frame — the final frame of the ritual beat: Aida seated beside the crystal bowl, perfectly still, eyes closed, her face lit in rose-pink from the glowing pendant. Begin naturally from it. Match its staging, light and position exactly. Do not repeat the ritual's action.
image_2 defines only the sanctuary environment: the quiet cove shoreline and the crystal bowl. Do not use or invent characters from it.
Exactly one Aida; no other characters appear. The rose quartz pendant and its pink glow belong to Aida only.
Feature-quality stylized 3D CGI. Plush character materials with subsurface scattering; soft fur with individual strands catching the light; glossy eyes with bright catchlights. Warm amber key light with cool blue fill and a soft rim light; teal-orange cinematic grade. Shallow depth of field with soft bokeh, gentle ambient occlusion, subtle film grain. Appealing exaggerated proportions, large expressive eyes, soft rounded features. Emotionally warm atmosphere.
Dialogue language: English. Aida speaks slow and sure, as if she already knows how it ends, going quieter the closer she gets to what matters. Only Aida speaks; no narrator, no crowd, no added speech.

Shot 1 — the return. Camera: close on Aida as the pink glow fades gently from her eyes and they open. She places a paw over her heart. A soft knowing smile arrives by degrees, not all at once. She says softly, certain, almost to herself: {It's time.} Hold the pose for a full beat after the line finishes; keep her expression for two full seconds after the line ends.

Shot 2 — the exit. She rises gracefully in one unhurried movement, turns, and walks purposefully toward the treeline as the bowl's note fades into the sound of distant wind <bowl tone fading, low wind rising>. The camera holds and lets her go. End state: Aida walking away into the forest edge, the cove quiet behind her — a describable frame.

The singing-bowl tone is diegetic sound, not music. No music. No subtitles, captions or on-screen text. No watermark. No extra characters.
